'''Turan Tovuz''' ({{IPA|az|tuɾɑn tovuz|pron}}) is an [[Azerbaijan]]i professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Tovuz, Azerbaijan|Tovuz]]. The club won the [[Azerbaijan Premier League|Azerbaijan championship]] once, in [[1994–95 Azerbaijan Top League|1994–95]]. The club's home stadium is [[Tovuz City Stadium]]."}}
